content: The written notice of termination must typically be received by the current insurer **at least 30 days before the end of the policy period** (in this case, the end of the year). This timeframe allows the insurer sufficient time to process the notice and arrange for the policy switch. However, the exact deadline can vary depending on the specific terms of your insurance contract or local regulations. It's always best to check the policy documentation or contact the insurer directly for precise details.
